identity.name: Varun Rout
identity.headline: Football Research Engineer | Sports Quantitative Modelling, Forecasting and Decision Systems
identity.location: Birmingham, UK | Open to London relocation

summary: Football Research Engineer with four years across predictive modelling, forecasting and production data systems, applying statistical learning to sports and trading questions. Builds reproducible pipelines from noisy event data through held-out evaluation, benchmark comparison and deployment, proven by audited football models, improved power-market forecasts, sports demand forecasting and close collaboration with analysts, commercial stakeholders and traders.

skills.items: Opponent-adjusted metrics, possession-danger modelling, contextual xG/xA/xT, StatsBomb event and 360 data
Logistic regression, ridge, gradient boosting, XGBoost, GRU, graph neural networks, time-series forecasting
Held-out and cross-validation, Brier score, log loss, ROC AUC, incumbent benchmarking, calibration, temporal leakage controls
Python, SQL, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Azure ML Studio, GitHub Actions
Hypothesis design, reproducible experiments, trader and analyst collaboration, model limitations, decision-ready communication

roles.title: Market Analyst
bullets: Built residual-load models linking demand net of wind and solar to power prices, reducing hourly forecast RMSE by 0.3-0.5 GWh/h across near and far seasons.
Selected a three-year training window after testing multiple regimes, excluding the exceptional 2022 period, and implemented monitoring for relationship and feature-distribution drift.
Used Azure ML Studio and Azure DevOps to deliver models and communicate assumptions, errors and market drivers to analysts, commercial teams and shape meetings.

roles.title: Costing and Risk Intern
bullets: Built a half-hourly DUoS/TNUoS forecasting engine and 10,000-run Monte Carlo scenarios producing P5/P50/P95 cost outcomes under changing consumption and tariff assumptions.
Migrated spreadsheet and Access processes into Python, SQL and Snowflake workflows, saving 6-7 hours per reporting cycle.

experience.title: Business Analytics Consultant
bullets: Benchmarked SARIMA, Prophet, Holt-Winters and Random Forest models for six sports activity categories using out-of-sample MAE and GridSearchCV.
Used booking, attendance and membership data to translate seasonal demand forecasts into staffing, scheduling and capacity recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Built multi-horizon demand forecasts and product segmentation across approximately 7,000 SKUs, improving planning visibility through automated reporting.

experience.title: Systems Engineer
bullets: Built and maintained production data pipelines and SQL transformations using Azure Data Factory and Databricks, with documentation and controls for reliable downstream reporting.

projects.title: Opponent-Adjusted Football Metrics

Built a FastAPI and PostgreSQL research service with SQLAlchemy, Alembic, 332 tests and CI covering linting, typing, database smoke tests and security checks.

projects.title: Frame2Threat
